subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous set of compiler-generated and runtime helper routines (BooleanToIntConversion thunks, scalar-deleting destructors, heap allocator wrappers, flag/byte field mutators, small lookup helpers) whose owning object types are not identified by the packet. Grouping here reflects shared call/field evidence only; no claim of a single domain class.

summary: 45 generic runtime-object functions reconstructed from validated IR. The majority (28) are small wrappers, mutators, and guards with no identifiable owning class; three defensible GUESS groupings emerge from shared evidence: (1) a family of compiler-generated thunks that forward a fixed function address to the BooleanToIntConversion helper at 0x00587B3E, (2) a driver-table container whose entries live at object base + 916 with a 140-byte stride and a count at +0x3E14, and (3) a visibility-grid accumulator object holding a float at +0x68 that is incremented/threshold-checked or decremented/clamped. Two MSVC scalar-deleting destructors and several allocate-and-init wrappers over module globals are recognized as idiomatic shapes with unknown concrete types. All proposals are DERIVED or GUESS; no CONFIRMED/FACT claims are made.

Conditional collector (legacy label collectAudioSourceEntry): when bit 0 of the byte at this+0x1C is set, appends the dword at this+0x18 into the global array dword_7CC9CC at index dword_7CD07C and increments that counter; returns whether the counter is below 8. Audio-source interpretation is unconfirmed.

Stores -abs(a2) into this+0xC7C and -abs(a3) into this+0xC80. Straight-line float magnitude setter; target fields per existing analysis were surface constants. The flagged global flt_59E440 does not appear in the raw body.

Accumulates byte argument a2 into the byte at offset 0 of buffer a1, then calls UIInputPropertySetter (0x0044F6F6) with arguments the decompiler reports as uninitialized locals (positive-sp warning); returns 0.

One-shot activation capture (legacy label ConditionalFieldSetterWithState): with override this+0x8 set, always stores input into this+0x10; otherwise captures the first non-zero input into this+0x10 and sets state this+0xC = 1, resets state on zero input, and clears this+0x10 on re-activation; returns the input in all paths. Called by sub_4537B0.

PAUSE-menu key-name string copier: gated by count at this+0xC88 > 0, writes the index byte at this+0xC8C to *a3, and copies a NUL-terminated string from table aPause_0 (0x005C4890, 16-byte stride, index < 0x5A) or from table aEmpty_0 (0x005C4E30, via index-128, bound 0x58) into output a2; returns 1 on copy, 0 when gated or out of range.

Per-entry swept-interval overlap test (legacy label SweptAABBOverlapDetection): selects a data base at this+3464 or this+4484 by selector a3, rejects when the scaled interval test is below -0.34999999, and on overlap writes float bit pattern 1056964608 or 1065353216 into dword_7D1490[216*a3 + 27*a2] depending on the caller input at a4 + 4*a2; returns 1/0. Called by sub_454350.

Scalar-deleting destructor shape: writes the global pointer off_59EFCC into this[0], frees this[1] (offset 0x4) via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, and frees this itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf when (a2 & 1) is set; returns this. Structural twin of 004562A0 extended with the delete-this branch.
Unconditional byte flag setter: writes literal 1 to the byte at this+0x7C. No guards, globals, or callees; owning object unknown.
Single-call delegation wrapper: invokes the object-allocation routine with the address of global dword_7CD204 and returns the allocation result directly.
Scalar-deleting destructor: runs DestructorWithResourceCleanup (0x0045B400) on this, then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the low bit of the deletion flag a2 is set, and returns this.

Object allocator: allocates an 812-byte block via the operator-new wrapper 0x00587C03, initializes it with 0x0045BB40 on success and stores the pointer into this[0], or stores 0 on failure; returns this.
BooleanToIntConversion thunk: passes the code address of sub_45BE80 (AVIStreamGlobalCleanup) to the helper at 0x00587B3E and returns its result.

Global AVI-stream cleanup: passes the address of global dword_7CD208 to AVIStreamCleanup (0x0045BEA0), snapshots the global, and frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the global was non-null; returns the free result or the null snapshot.

Audio-channel storage init: allocates a 118368-byte block via the operator-new wrapper; on success runs AudioChannelInit on the storage at global dword_7CD25C and stores the result into dword_7CD25C[0], on failure stores 0; returns the dword_7CD25C pointer. Raw source writes the global despite the packet's rw=R label.
BooleanToIntConversion thunk: passes the code address of sub_45C000 (closeHandleIfOpen) to the helper at 0x00587B3E and returns its result.

Guarded handle close: when the byte flag at 0x007CD26C is non-zero, closes the cached handle dword_7CD264 via CloseHandle (import thunk 0x0059E1A8) and clears it on success; returns the flag byte or the CloseHandle result.
Writes parameter a2 into the byte at this+0x0 and a3 into the byte at this+0x1; returns a2.
Computes the difference of the __int16 values pointed to by a1 and a2 and returns it as int. __cdecl helper with no this context; the packet's field:this:0 entry is a template artifact.

State-gated setter: calls StateCheckWrapper (0x00461DC0) on global dword_7CD25C; when it passes, calls sub_45CD70(this) and sets the byte at this+1 to the value of global byte_7D0F94 (1 or 0); returns the state-check result or the flag value. Called by 0x00463F70.

Flag-dispatch helper (legacy label StringLengthCheckDispatch): returns early when this[0] is zero; otherwise when this[1] is non-zero calls the inactivity-timeout handler on the off_5E4DFC pointer, then calls NetworkPacketReceive on both paths and returns its result. Invoked by SessionScoringUpdate (0x004643C0).
Bit-field mutator (legacy label SetOrClearFlagBit): builds mask 1 << a2 and sets or clears that bit in the byte at this+0x6E according to boolean a3; returns the (possibly inverted) mask.

Forwarder: dereferences this, reads the COM interface pointer at obj+0x3FB8, passes it to ShortComputation_a820 (0x0057A820), and returns the unsigned-byte result. Called by InputCommandDispatchToEntities (0x0045F4A0).

Counts driver-table entries with flag bit 2 set (legacy label FlaggedDriverCount): gated by the driver count at obj+0x3E14 > 0, iterates 140-byte-stride entries starting at obj+916 calling FlagBitTest (0x00461530) per entry, and returns the count.

Driver-entry lookup by ID byte (legacy label DriverDataCopyByID): gated by the driver count at obj+0x3E14 > 0, iterates 140-byte-stride entries starting at obj+916, compares the ID byte at entry+0x7C with a2, and on match qmemcpys the 0x8C-byte block at entry+916 into a3 and writes the parallel dword (obj + 15476 + 4*index) into *a4; returns 1 on match else 0. Used by 0x0045D890 and 0x0046E1B0.
Trivial stdcall passthrough (legacy label PathRegistryCallWrapper): forwards its single argument to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and returns that result unchanged. Sole caller sub_45D2D0.
Getter: reads the pointer at this+0, adds 284 (0x11C), and returns that string pointer when the NUL-terminated string there is non-empty, else NULL.

Guarded radio-message pump: when the state flag at obj+0x3FC4 (obj = *this) is non-zero, calls sub_57A730(256) and then TeamRadioNetworkMessageProcessing(obj), returning its result; otherwise returns the object primary pointer. Called by GamePostMainLoop (0x0042D8A0).

State-guarded delegation: dereferences this to obj and, when the dword at obj+0x3FC4 equals 3, calls the particle/sound spawner on obj and returns its result; on state != 3 the fall-through return is an uninitialized decompiler artifact. Invoked by sub_4A00A0.
Allocates a 58832-byte buffer, initializes a large struct into global dword_7CD2A8 (via LargeStructInitialization on success, 0 on failure), and returns the address of dword_7CD2A8.
BooleanToIntConversion thunk: calls the helper at 0x00587B3E with the int-cast address of sub_464950 (0x00464950) and returns the result. Referenced routine is passed by address, not invoked.
Thin wrapper (legacy label CallHandlerOnLargeStruct): calls sub_465000 with the address of global dword_7CD2A8 and returns its integer result.

Squared-distance query: reads the entity pointer from this[0], computes squared Euclidean distance between entity offsets +0x75/+0x79/+0x7D and reference a2[3384..3386], stores the sum into this[1] (offset +0x4), and returns the entity pointer. Called by EntityVisibilityGridManager (0x00465460).

Accumulator with threshold check: adds the float input a2 to this[26] (offset +0x68), stores the sum back, and returns true when the accumulated value is >= threshold a3. Called by EntityVisibilityGridManager (0x00465460).

Decrements the float field this[26] (offset +0x68) by a2 and clamps the result into [0.0, a2]; always writes the field. Called by EntityVisibilityGridManager (0x00465460). The flagged global flt_59E440 does not appear in the raw body.
Clears the byte at this[0] to 0 and returns the this pointer. No static callers recorded.
Buffer-size lookup: maps selector a1 through the jump table at 0x00464ECC to a fixed size (1 -> 2975, 2 -> 7200, 3 -> 28800, 4 -> 625000, default 1487). Called by 0x00464EE0 and 0x00465430.

Counter-gated delegate (legacy label ConditionalDelegateBasedOnCounter): returns the counter at this[20] (offset +0x50) directly when positive, otherwise delegates to BufferSizeLookup(*this) and returns its result. Called by DivisionWithCapComputation (0x00464F50).

classes.name: BooleanToIntConversionThunks
classes.responsibility: Compiler-generated thunk family: each member passes a fixed function address (code address or stub-pointer global) as the single argument to the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper at 0x00587B3E and returns the coerced integer result. The pattern is uniform across members; whether the helper registers (atexit-style), invokes, or merely coerces the pointer value is not established. Grouping reflects the shared callee and identical call shape, not a proven domain class.

classes.name: DriverTableContainer
classes.responsibility: Hosts a per-driver table reached through the object pointer stored at this+0: the driver count lives at obj+0x3E14 and driver entries are 140-byte blocks starting at obj+916, each carrying an ID byte (entry+0x7C) and flag bits. Exposes a counted walk (FlaggedDriverCount) and an ID-keyed lookup that copies a matched entry into a caller buffer (DriverDataCopyByID). Layout values are DERIVED from raw source text, not from the deterministic field list.

classes.name: VisibilityAccumulator
classes.responsibility: Per-object float accumulator/timer at +0x68 used by the visibility-grid manager (0x00465460): one method adds a caller-supplied increment and reports whether the accumulated value crossed a threshold, the other decrements by a caller-supplied amount and clamps into [0.0, amount]. Common ownership is inferred from the shared base-this offset +0x68 and the shared caller; the field's semantic role is not otherwise evidenced.

state_machines.name: ConditionalCaptureActivation
transitions: inactive + non-zero input -> active (capture input into this+0x10, set this+0xC = 1)
active + zero input -> inactive (reset this+0xC = 0, clear this+0x10)
active + new non-zero input -> active (clear this+0x10 without re-capturing)
any + override this+0x8 non-zero -> override (always store input into this+0x10)

compatibility_contracts.name: ScalarDeletingDestructorConvention
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x0045B3E0 and 0x004562C0 follow the MSVC scalar-deleting destructor convention: they return the this pointer, and the low bit of the second argument (a2 & 1) selects whether the object itself is freed through the FreeWrapper_7bcf allocation domain. A replacement executable exposing these slots must preserve this convention and the free-domain pairing.

compatibility_contracts.name: BufferSizeSelectorTable
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x00464E90 maps a selector argument to a fixed buffer size through the jump table at 0x00464ECC: 1 -> 2975, 2 -> 7200, 3 -> 28800, 4 -> 625000, any other value -> 1487. Callers 0x00464EE0 and 0x00465430 rely on these exact sizes.

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioSourceCollectionSink
compatibility_contracts.description: 0x0044EDD0 appends a source dword into the global array dword_7CC9CC indexed by the counter dword_7CD07C, gated on bit 0 of the source entry flag byte at this+0x1C, and reports buffer-not-full while the counter is below 8. Consumers of dword_7CC9CC depend on this 8-slot collection contract.

unresolved: The purpose of BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) is not established: atexit-style registration, function-pointer invocation, or mere integer coercion are all unproven; the thunk family is grouped on call-shape evidence only.
The null-stub targets nullsub_165/167/168/180/183/185/187/188 have no bodies; their intended callback behavior is unrecoverable from this packet.
Owner object types are unidentified for the majority of functions (28 of 45), including all allocators, destructors, flag setters, and lookup helpers; these remain UnknownObject.
The PAUSE-string copy tables aPause_0 (0x005C4890) and aEmpty_0 (0x005C4E30) contents are unknown beyond the 16-byte stride.

The driver-table geometry (entries at obj+916, 140-byte stride, ID at entry+0x7C, parallel dword table at obj+15476) is DERIVED from raw source text only and is absent from the deterministic field list.
flt_59E440 is flagged as read by 0x0044F010 and 0x00464BD0 but never appears in either raw body; flt_59EF7C/flt_59EF80 are similarly flagged for 0x004542D0 but absent from its raw source.
Packet labels dword_7CD25C and dword_7CD2A8 as read-only (rw=R) even though raw source writes them; raw source is treated as authoritative.
The 118368-byte audio-channel allocation and the 58832-byte large struct imply fixed layouts that are not established by this packet.
The 812-byte layout produced by initializer 0x0045BB40 is outside packet coverage.

0x0045D4E0 returns an uninitialized local on its this[0] == 0 path and 0x00463E00 returns an uninitialized local on its state != 3 path; both are decompiler artifacts whose real fall-through values are unproven.
0x0044F5E2 passes uninitialized locals to UIInputPropertySetter under a positive-sp compiler warning; the rendered call arguments may be wrong.
Whether FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) is operator delete or a custom free is unverified, so allocation-domain pairing for the destructors and AVI-stream cleanup is unproven.
The entity struct referenced by 0x00464990 (offsets +0x75/+0x79/+0x7D) and the reference object a2 (indices 3384..3386) are unidentified.

State values of obj+0x3FC4 (non-zero gate in 0x00463CA0 vs equality-3 gate in 0x00463E00) may belong to one shared object but common ownership is not proven; they are left as separate UnknownObject entries.
Which of the 45 functions are vtable slots versus free functions is not evidenced by this packet; 0x004562C0's write of off_59EFCC to slot 0 is treated as a vtable/base-pointer pattern, not proven.
